messages:
maria: Hey — nightly small-batch e2e gate just went red on canary. Seeing p95 latency ~2.3x higher and throughput drop. Job: ci-e2e-smallbatch-nightly #237. Logs: https://ci.internal/ci-e2e-smallbatch/237

ci-bot: build #237 failed: 1 failing test. Failing test: `TestSmallBatchLatency::p95_regression`. Summary: https://ci.internal/ci-e2e-smallbatch/237/summary

alex: on it. Any suspected PRs/commits in the window?

maria: suspect range bc12f3..d4e8a0. Likely PRs: #4123 (batch scheduler tweak), #4130 (kv-cache micro-optim). Also traces show longer avg seq lengths for a subset of requests.

alex: trying quick local repro: `./scripts/run_e2e --profile smallbatch --iters 100` — hitting a p95 spike around iter 7. dumping trace to /tmp/smallbatch-trace.pb. snippet from the worker log:
```
[2026-03-17T01:12:07Z] step=decode seq=512 latency=21ms
[2026-03-17T01:12:10Z] step=attn   seq=1024 latency=120ms  <-- spike
[2026-03-17T01:12:10Z] step=kvcache flush=true
AssertionError: p95 > baseline_threshold (2.34x)
```

ryan: can we try a rerun on CI first before bisecting? Might be a transient noisy-neighbor. I'll trigger a rerun.

ryan: `jenkins job build ci-e2e-smallbatch-nightly #237 --rebuild`

ci-bot: rerun queued at https://ci.internal/ci-e2e-smallbatch/237/retry-1. Status: queued.

ops-robot: FYI canary-gpu-pool usage currently 82%. There were a couple of other heavy runs around the same time window. Possible noisy neighbor impact.

maria: good call. if rerun fails, alex — can you bisect the bc12f3..d4e8a0 range?

alex: yes, will bisect if rerun fails. assigning to myself.

ci-bot: rerun finished: PASSED. All tests green. Link: https://ci.internal/ci-e2e-smallbatch/237/retry-1

maria: rerun passed — marking as likely flake / transient noisy neighbor. I'll add a note on the nightly incident board and watch for recurrence for 24h.

alex: leaving bisect parked. I'll follow up if we see a repro. Also adding a small guard in the batch scheduler PR to log longer seqs for triage.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging @oncall-ml to keep an eye on model infra metrics today. :thumbsup:
